summary: Cyclobenzaprine Hydrochloride has a warning for a potentially life-threatening reaction called serotonin syndrome when taken together with certain other medicines [4]. In tests using a small computer model rather than people, the drug received a low score for liver concerns and a high score for heart concerns [M]. A similar drug named Doxepin carries a strong boxed warning in the United States regarding mental health effects [3].
